subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Which official OpenClaw release containing the installDaemon=false wizard contract should the Windows Companion pin and support?
rationale: The branch cannot be independently merge-ready because its successful behavior depends on a protocol correction outside this repository and outside the official package currently selected by the diff.

options.title: Wait for corrected official release
options.body: Keep the PR draft and update the pin only when an official OpenClaw artifact includes the required wizard behavior and passes setup E2E.

options.title: Select another supported artifact
options.body: Choose a different official version that already satisfies the ownership contract and rerun all setup proof against that exact artifact.

options.title: Split independent formatting
options.body: Land the culture-invariant formatting separately while pausing the coupled setup and version work.

recommendation.title: Wait for corrected official release
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft and update the pin only when an official OpenClaw artifact includes the required wizard behavior and passes setup E2E.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice controls the Windows Companion's supported installation and release coupling, making the repository co-creator the best available routing candidate.
